title: Juicy Chinese Pork Dumplings
description: A traditional Xinjiang dish featuring minced pork and steam cooked to perfection, this recipe is gluten-free friendly and offers a deliciously fermented flavor.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the minced pork, chopped Chinese cabbage, grated ginger, and minced garlic, and mix well until just combined.
Add the sesame oil, soy sauce, and salt to the pork mixture and mix until the ingredients are evenly distributed.
Lay a wonton wrapper on a clean surface and place a small spoonful of the pork mixture in the center of the wrapper.
Dip your finger in a small amount of water and run it along the edges of the wonton wrapper.
Fold the wonton wrapper into a triangle by bringing the two opposite corners together to form a point, and press the edges together to seal the dumpling.
Repeat the process with the remaining wonton wrappers and pork mixture.
In a large pot with a steamer basket, bring 2 inches of water to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and place the dumplings in the steamer basket, leaving some space between each dumpling.
Cover the pot with a lid and steam the dumplings for 15 minutes, or until they are cooked through and the wrappers are tender.
Serve the dumplings hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
